description: READ-ONLY. Vendor Central trading terms (Vendor accounts only). Amazon SP-API does not expose trading terms (payment terms, discounts, agreements) for reading, so this tool returns an explanation of the limitation and points to Vendor Central and to get_vendor_remittances for net cost per purchase order.
